description: The utility SHALL store the management endpoint URL and payment identifier as Base64-encoded `char` arrays in the source code and decode them at runtime using a `base64_decode()` function implemented in the same file. When extracting `session_token` from the file, the utility SHALL locate it using `strstr()` and advance the resulting pointer by exactly `strlen("\"session_token\":\"")` bytes, which equals 11 bytes.
name: management_endpoint_and_session_token_processing
